The complete document, remaining array values, column lengths and original final file/directory stability checks still run. An early bracket or rejected prefix cannot publish partial counts.

The only test diff adds four tails after 20,000 primitive values: quoted bracket/comma text, a nested object, a nested list and null, followed by another JSON member. Fast and fully structural results must agree.

The controlled input, one-million row assertion, failure frame 450, reason instrumentation, cooperative 30-second budget, memory/value/row bounds, duplicate and finite-number checks, unknown semantics, compilation inputs and resource limits are unchanged.
